claim_reachability.reason: The observed-cell association is reachable and executable, but source-to-cell collection lineage is incomplete, exact source/code freezing is incomplete, and high-risk confounders remain unresolved.
No independent biological validation path exists and the only support edge is inferred.
Cell-level observational data do not provide an intervention path, tissue response evidence, or authorized translational validation.

next_evidence_action.action: Locate an independent dataset with explicit biological grouping and per-sample collection metadata; if unavailable, obtain independently collected biological replicates through an authorized partner laboratory.
